versions.description_html:
Learn how KQL databases in Microsoft Fabric help you query log and telemetry data without SQL overwhelm. Get clear, jargon-free insights today.

Your team can collect every alert, every click, every device signal, then still miss the one change that needed a response. The data keeps arriving, but it lands as noise because nobody can ask it a clear question.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Opening: The Query Language That Makes Noise Useful
  • Eventhouse, KQL Database, and Tables
  • When KQL Is the Right Tool
  • KQL Without the SQL Overwhelm
  • Working With Time-Series and Log Data
  • Getting Started in Fabric and Putting Insight to Work
  • Conclusion: Start With One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
